verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel que me tragam uma oferta alçada; de todo homem cujo coração se mover voluntariamente, dele tomareis a minha oferta alçada.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel that they are to make me an offering; from every man who has the impulse in his heart take an offering for me.

verses.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.pt: E esta é a oferta alçada que tomareis deles: ouro, prata, bronze,
verses.en_web: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, brass,
verses.en_bbe: And this is the offering you are to take from them: gold and silver and brass;

verses.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats hair,
verses.pt: estofo azul, púrpura, carmesim, linho fino, pêlos de cabras,
verses.en_web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
verses.en_bbe: And blue and purple and red, and the best linen, and goats' hair;

verses.en: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.pt: peles de carneiros tintas de vermelho, peles de golfinhos, madeira de acácia,
verses.en_web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
verses.en_bbe: And sheepskins coloured red, and leather, and hard wood;

verses.en: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.pt: azeite para a luz, especiarias para o óleo da unção e para o incenso aromàtico,
verses.en_web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
verses.en_bbe: Oil for the light, spices for the sweet-smelling oil, sweet perfumes for burning;

verses.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.pt: pedras de ônix, e pedras de engaste para o éfode e para o peitoral.
verses.en_web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
verses.en_bbe: Beryls and stones of value to be put on the ephod and on the priest's bag.

verses.en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.pt: E me farão um santuário, para que eu habite no meio deles.
verses.en_web: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.en_bbe: And let them make me a holy place, so that I may be ever present among them.

verses.en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.pt: Conforme a tudo o que eu te mostrar para modelo do tabernáculo, e para modelo de todos os seus móveis, assim mesmo o fareis.
verses.en_web: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
verses.en_bbe: Make the House and everything in it from the designs which I will give you.

verses.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.pt: Também farão uma arca de madeira ,de acácia; o seu comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e a sua largura de um côvado e meio, e de um côvado e meio a sua altura.
verses.en_web: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.en_bbe: And they are to make an ark of hard wood; two and a half cubits long, and a cubit and a half wide and high.

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.pt: E cobri-la-ás de ouro puro, por dentro e por fora a cobrirás; e farás sobre ela uma moldura de ouro ao redor;
verses.en_web: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
verses.en_bbe: It is to be plated inside and out with the best gold, with an edge of gold all round it

verses.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.pt: e fundirás para ela quatro argolas de ouro, que porás nos quatro cantos dela; duas argolas de um lado e duas do outro.
verses.en_web: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.en_bbe: And make four rings of gold for it, to be fixed on its four feet, two rings on one side of it and two on the other.

verses.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.pt: Também farás varais de madeira de acácia, que cobrirás de ouro.
verses.en_web: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.en_bbe: And make rods of the same wood, plating them with gold.

verses.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.pt: Meterás os varais nas argolas, aos lados da arca, para se levar por eles a arca.
verses.en_web: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
verses.en_bbe: And put the rods through the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.

verses.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.pt: Os varais permanecerão nas argolas da arca; não serão tirados dela.
verses.en_web: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
verses.en_bbe: The rods are to be kept in the rings, and never taken out.

verses.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.pt: E porás na arca o testemunho, que eu te darei.
verses.en_web: You shall put the testimony which I shall give you into the ark.
verses.en_bbe: Inside the ark you are to put the record which I will give you.

verses.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.pt: Igualmente farás um propiciatório, de ouro puro; o seu comprimento será de dois covados e meio, e a sua largura de um côvado e meio.
verses.en_web: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a cover of the best gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

verses.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.pt: Farás também dois querubins de ouro; de ouro batido os farás, nas duas extremidades do propiciatório.
verses.en_web: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.en_bbe: And at the two ends of the cover you are to make two winged ones of hammered gold,

verses.en: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.pt: Farás um querubim numa extremidade e o outro querubim na outra extremidade; de uma só peça com o propiciatório fareis os querubins nas duas extremidades dele.
verses.en_web: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
verses.en_bbe: One at one end and one at the other; the winged ones are to be part of the cover.

verses.en: And the cherubim shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.pt: Os querubins estenderão as suas asas por cima do propiciatório, cobrindo-o com as asas, tendo as faces voltadas um para o outro; as faces dos querubins estarão voltadas para o propiciatório.
verses.en_web: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
verses.en_bbe: And their wings are to be outstretched over the cover, and the winged ones are to be opposite one another, facing the cover.

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.pt: E porás o propiciatório em cima da arca; e dentro da arca porás o testemunho que eu te darei.
verses.en_web: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I will give you.
verses.en_bbe: And put the cover over the ark, and in the ark the record which I will give you.

verses.en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E ali virei a ti, e de cima do propiciatório, do meio dos dois querubins que estão sobre a arca do testemunho, falarei contigo a respeito de tudo o que eu te ordenar no tocante aos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the testimony, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And there, between the two winged ones on the cover of the ark, I will come to you, face to face, and make clear to you all the orders I have to give you for the children of Israel.

verses.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.pt: Também farás uma mesa de madeira de acácia; o seu comprimento será de dois côvados, a sua largura de um côvado e a sua altura de um côvado e meio;
verses.en_web: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a table of the same wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high,

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.pt: cobri-la-ás de ouro puro, e lhe farás uma moldura de ouro ao redor.
verses.en_web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
verses.en_bbe: Plated with the best gold, with a gold edge all round it;

verses.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.pt: Também lhe farás ao redor uma guarnição de quatro dedos de largura, e ao redor na guarnição farás uma moldura de ouro.
verses.en_web: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
verses.en_bbe: And make a frame all round it, as wide as a man's hand, with a gold edge to the frame.

verses.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.pt: Também lhe farás quatro argolas de ouro, e porás as argolas nos quatro cantos, que estarão sobre os quatro pés.
verses.en_web: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
verses.en_bbe: And make four gold rings and put them at the four angles, on the four feet of the table;

verses.en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.pt: Junto da guarnição estarão as argolas, como lugares para os varais, para se levar a mesa.
verses.en_web: the rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.en_bbe: The rings are to be fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table is to be lifted.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.pt: Farás, pois, estes varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobrirás de ouro; e levar-se-á por eles a mesa.
verses.en_web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
verses.en_bbe: Make rods of the same wood, plated with gold, for lifting the table.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.pt: Também farás os seus pratos, as suas colheres, os seus cântaros e as suas tigelas com que serão oferecidas as libações; de ouro puro os farás.
verses.en_web: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls to pour out offerings with. You shall make them of pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: And make the table-vessels, the spoons and the cups and the basins for liquids, all of the best gold.

verses.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.pt: E sobre a mesa porás os pães da o proposição perante mim para sempre.
verses.en_web: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
verses.en_bbe: And on the table at all times you are to keep my holy bread.

verses.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.pt: Também farás um candelabro de ouro puro; de ouro batido se fará o candelabro, tanto o seu pedestal como a sua haste; os seus copos, os seus cálices e as suas corolas formarão com ele uma só peça.
verses.en_web: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. Of hammered work shall the lamp stand be made, even its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a support for lights, of the best gold; its base and its pillar are to be of hammered gold; its cups, its buds, and its flowers are to be made of the same metal.

verses.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.pt: E de seus lados sairão seis braços: três de um lado, e três do outro.
verses.en_web: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
verses.en_bbe: It is to have six branches coming out from its sides; three branches from one side and three from the other.

verses.en: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.pt: Em um braço haverá três copos a modo de flores de amêndoa, com cálice e corola; também no outro braço três copos a modo de flores de amêndoa, com cálice e corola; assim se farão os seis braços que saem do candelabro.
verses.en_web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
verses.en_bbe: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower, on all the branches.

verses.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.pt: Mas na haste central haverá quatro copos a modo de flores de amêndoa, com os seus cálices e as suas corolas,
verses.en_web: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.en_bbe: And on the pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower:

verses.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.pt: e um cálice debaixo de dois braços, formando com a haste uma só peça; outro cálice debaixo de dois outros braços, de uma só peça com a haste; e ainda outro cálice debaixo de dois outros braços, de uma só peça com a haste; assim será para os seis braços que saem do candelabro.
verses.en_web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.en_bbe: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all the six branches of it.

verses.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.pt: Os seus cálices e os seus braços formarão uma só peça com a haste; o todo será de obra batida de ouro puro.
verses.en_web: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: The buds and the branches are to be made of the same metal; all together one complete work of hammered gold.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.pt: Também lhe farás sete lâmpadas, as quais se acenderão para alumiar defronte dele.
verses.en_web: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
verses.en_bbe: Then you are to make its seven vessels for the lights, putting them in their place so that they give light in front of it.

verses.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.pt: Os seus espevitadores e os seus cinzeiros serão de ouro puro.
verses.en_web: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: And the instruments and trays for use with it are all to be of the best gold.

verses.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.pt: De um talento de ouro puro se fará o candelabro, com todos estes utensílios.
verses.en_web: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
verses.en_bbe: A talent of gold will be needed for it, with all these vessels.

verses.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.pt: Atenta, pois, que os faças conforme o seu modelo, que te foi mostrado no monte.
verses.en_web: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
verses.en_bbe: And see that you make them from the design which you saw on the mountain.
